_metadata.description: Tunnel health & metrics: cloudflared systemd/ready health, Prometheus metrics scraping with SQLite time-series, and degraded-mode detection.

requirements.title: Report cloudflared health from systemd status and /ready
requirements.description: The tunnel monitor combines cloudflared systemd unit status and the cloudflared /ready endpoint into a single health status, reporting unhealthy when either signal fails.

requirements.title: Scrape cloudflared Prometheus metrics into SQLite time-series
requirements.description: The monitor scrapes the cloudflared Prometheus endpoint (default 127.0.0.1:20241) for HA connections, request errors, RTT, and active streams, and persists timestamped samples in the metrics table.

requirements.title: Detect degraded mode before full failure
requirements.description: When HA connections drop below 4 or RTT spikes beyond threshold the monitor reports a degraded status distinct from healthy and failed, ahead of a full outage.
